senses.gloss: f. (נָגַף) striking, injury through collision, pushing &c. Mekh. Mishp., s. 12 (ref. to Ex. XXI, 35) [read:] בכלל נ׳ נגיחה וכ׳ striking includes goring, pushing &c.; Yalk. Ex. 341.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 2b:10">B. Kam. 2ᵇ</cite>; a. fr., v. <cite ref="N00159"><he>נְגִיחָה</he></cite>.
